title: 10 Large-Cap Stocks Reporting Earnings Next Week That Tickeron's AI Flags as Winners
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Key takeaways:

* Tickeron's AI Trading Bots screened every large-cap name reporting earnings in the week of Aug 17–23 for proximity to 52-week highs and technical momentum, not just headline size.
* Six of the ten picks are within 1% of new highs going into earnings — [APGE](https://tickeron.com/ticker/APGE/), [ORKA](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ORKA/), [LLYVK](https://tickeron.com/ticker/LLYVK/), and [LLYVA](https://tickeron.com/ticker/LLYVA/) among them — a tight breakout cluster going into their reports.
* [ORKA](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ORKA/) is the standout, up +266.35% YTD and still just 0.30% below its own 52-week high.
* Biggest laggard-turned-value-play: [TLK](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TLK/), down -29.47% YTD but bouncing into earnings.
* Tickeron's Financial Learning Models are tracking sector rotation into commodities/materials ([BHP](https://tickeron.com/ticker/BHP/), [KGS](https://tickeron.com/ticker/KGS/)) and biotech ([APGE](https://tickeron.com/ticker/APGE/), [ORKA](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ORKA/)) heading into this earnings window.

[**BHP**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/BHP/) **— BHP Group Limited**  
Trading at **$86.78** (-0.52% today), BHP is up **+43.77%** YTD and sits just 7.51% below its 52-week high of $93.83 (low: $51.83). Market cap: $220.45B. Tickeron's AI flagged BHP for this basket on commodity-cycle strength into its earnings report and a technical setup close enough to the yearly high to matter. **30-day forecast: bullish.**

[**ASTS**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ASTS/) **— AST SpaceMobile, Inc.**  
At **$70.98** (-0.76% today), ASTS is roughly flat YTD at **-2.30%**, with a 52-week range of $36.08–$133.86. Market cap: $28.88B. Tickeron's AI included ASTS for its outsized volatility profile into earnings — satellite-to-phone connectivity names swing hard on guidance, making it a high-beta earnings-week name. **30-day forecast: bullish, high volatility.**

[**TLK**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/TLK/) **— Telekomunikasi Indonesia (Telkom Indonesia)**  
Shares trade at **$14.84** (+1.02% today) and remain down **-29.47%** YTD, well off the $23.52 high but above the $13.23 low. Market cap: $14.63B. Tickeron's AI flagged TLK as the deep-value name in this basket — a beaten-down ADR showing a fresh green day heading into earnings. **30-day forecast: bullish reversal candidate.**

[**LLYVK**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/LLYVK/) **— Liberty Live Group (Series C)**  
At **$108.86** (+0.92% today), LLYVK is up **+30.97%** YTD and just 0.81% off its $109.75 high. Market cap: $10.02B. Tracking stock exposure to Live Nation/concert demand puts this near the top of Tickeron's breakout-proximity screen. **30-day forecast: bullish.**

[**LLYVA**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/LLYVA/) **— Liberty Live Group (Series A)**  
LLYVA trades at **$104.99** (+0.78% today), up **+28.77%** YTD and just 1.00% below its $106.06 high. Market cap: $9.99B. Same live-events tailwind as LLYVK, included as the twin share-class play. **30-day forecast: bullish.**

[**APGE**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/APGE/) **— Apogee Therapeutics, Inc.**  
At **$134.55** (+0.07% today), APGE has been the biotech story of the year, up **+78.28%** YTD and a mere 0.24% from its $134.88 high. Market cap: $8.33B. Tickeron's Pattern Trading Bots flag this as a near-complete breakout setup going into earnings. **30-day forecast: bullish.**

[**PACS**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/PACS/) **— PACS Group, Inc.**  
PACS is at **$44.44** (-1.22% today), up **+15.61%** YTD, 10.20% below its $49.49 high. Market cap: $7.04B. Post-acute/skilled-nursing demand plus a steady technical uptrend earned PACS a spot in the basket. **30-day forecast: bullish.**

[**VIPS**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/VIPS/) **— Vipshop Holdings Limited**  
At **$14.18** (+0.14% today), VIPS is down **-19.89%** YTD, 32.73% below its $21.08 high. Market cap: $6.98B. Tickeron's AI included VIPS as a China-retail value/rebound candidate heading into earnings. **30-day forecast: bullish rebound.**

[**ORKA**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/ORKA/) **— Oruka Therapeutics, Inc.**  
The biggest mover in this basket: ORKA trades at **$111.04** (+2.70% today), up **+266.35%** YTD, and only 0.30% off its $111.37 high. Market cap: $6.70B. Tickeron's AI Pattern Trading Bots rank this as one of the tightest breakout setups in the entire earnings-week universe. **30-day forecast: bullish.**

[**KGS**](https://tickeron.com/ticker/KGS/) **— Kodiak Gas Services, Inc.**  
KGS is at **$65.35** (+4.74% today, the largest daily gain in the large-cap basket), up **+74.78%** YTD, 15.87% below its $77.68 high. Market cap: $6.60B. Natural-gas compression demand and a strong pre-earnings pop put KGS on Tickeron's radar. **30-day forecast: bullish.**

**Tickeron's AI Trading Bots and Financial Learning Models:** Tickeron's AI Trading Bots continuously rotate exposure across sectors — commodities, biotech, and live-events/consumer — rather than holding a static list, which is how this basket blends BHP/KGS (materials & energy infrastructure) with APGE/ORKA (biotech breakouts) and LLYVK/LLYVA (consumer/events). Layered on top, Tickeron's AI Pattern Trading Bots use a proprietary Pattern Recognition Engine trained on more than 300 million historical price patterns to flag names like ORKA and APGE sitting within a fraction of a percent of new highs as coordinated breakout setups. Tickeron's Financial Learning Models (FLMs) specialize in detecting fast-moving sector rotations and trend changes — the same engine used to flag TLK and VIPS as value-rebound candidates rather than momentum names.
